text.heading: Repeated Template Support
text.supporting_text: The builder can now reuse the same approved template multiple times in one PPTX.

text.heading: First Text Insight
text.body:
This is the first use of the text-heavy insight template. It explains one strategic point in a controlled format.

The same template will be used again later with different content.

text.heading: Second Text Insight
text.body:
This is the second use of the same text-heavy template. The slide design stays consistent while the message changes.

This is important for real PDF-to-PPT generation.

text.heading: First Two-Block Slide
text.body_left: Left block explains the first point clearly.
text.body_right: Right block adds supporting context without changing design.

text.heading: Second Two-Block Slide
text.body_left: The same layout can be reused for another idea.
text.body_right: Repeated templates make the deck easier to scale.

text.heading: First Image Content
text.body: This slide uses the content-plus-image template for the first visual example.

text.heading: Second Image Content
text.body: This slide repeats the same image template with a different generated visual.

text.heading: Repeat Test Complete
text.subheading: Text, images, order, and repeated templates verified.
